fusions.name: Still-Water Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps the target for 30 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Reedbed Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges in a cone 2.5 tiles long, dealing 7 damage to everything in it. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: One-Legged Vigil
fusions.desc: Veils you for 7 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Worth the Wait
fusions.desc: The moment your health is full, your critical chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
